title: Optimization Overview Dashboard Response
description: GET {mount}/dashboards/optimization-overview on /api/v1/analytics, /api/v1beta/analytics and /api/v1beta/projects/{project_id}/analytics. Success envelope (success_response): {success, message, data}, with the dashboard payload under data. One analytics blueprint handler serves all three mounts and returns success_response(...), and success_envelope_schema.json's x-wrap-map lists analytics_routes under `wrapped`.
$comment: Added by TraigentSchema#591 review. The mounts previously pointed their 200 straight at project_scoped_optimization_overview_dashboard_schema.json, the bare payload, which a real response never matches. The payload schema is unchanged and remains the definition an SDK client validates after unwrapping; only the wire-level 200 moved to this envelope. The payload requires summary_cards.experiments_in_range, and the backend does emit it (core_domain_analytics_service.get_optimization_overview_dashboard, summary_cards.experiments_in_range), so a real response validates (the earlier claim that no producer emitted it, TraigentSchema#594, was stale).
